# 187 Growth Clinic (Yonsei Saebom Clinic)

> 187 Growth Clinic is a child growth clinic in Seoul, South Korea, directed by Dr. Chae Yong-hyun, physician focusing on children's height and growth. It provides free adult-height prediction and integrated growth care — growth hormone plus sex hormones, sleep, thyroid, nutrition, weight, and posture. English site: https://www.dr187growup.com/en/

## Key facts
- 187growup powered by Yonsei Saebom Medical Clinic — this site is an international information channel for the 187growup child growth program run by Yonsei Saebom Medical Clinic (Gangnam, Seoul). Official clinic website: https://www.yssaebomq.com
- Director: Dr. Chae Yong-hyun, physician focusing on children's height and growth.
- Focus: diagnosing *why* an individual child is not growing (bone age, sex hormones, sleep, thyroid, nutrition, weight, posture) rather than growth hormone alone.
- Free tool: an adult-height prediction calculator based on national growth-standard data (supports Korea, US/CDC, China, Thailand, Indonesia standards).
- Bone-age X-ray is used to estimate a child's remaining growth potential and predicted adult height.
- [Remote consultation](https://www.dr187growup.com/en/consult.html): Families abroad can share existing bone-age X-rays and blood test results for initial guidance. This is not telemedicine: no diagnosis, treatment plan or prescription is given remotely; all are made only after an in-person examination at our Seoul clinic.
- Contact (international): +82-10-6693-2838. Consultation via messenger from the site or through the main clinic: Yonsei Saebom Medical Clinic · +82-2-3395-0999 · https://www.yssaebomq.com/.

## Main pages
- [Free adult-height prediction calculator](https://www.dr187growup.com/en/calculator.html): Predict a child's adult height from age, sex, and current height using national growth standards.
- [About the clinic & director](https://www.dr187growup.com/en/#clinic): 187 Growth Clinic's integrated growth-care approach and Dr. Chae Yong-hyun.
- [Real treatment cases](https://www.dr187growup.com/en/cases.html): De-identified growth records of children treated at the clinic. The figures shown are from this child's own records; predicted adult height is an estimate, and the same outcome is not guaranteed for every child.
- [Blog — all articles](https://www.dr187growup.com/en/blog/): Doctor-written guides on child height and growth.

## Predicting & tracking height
- [Bone Age X-Ray & Height Prediction: A Guide](https://www.dr187growup.com/en/blog/bone-age-x-ray-height-prediction-guide/): How bone age from a hand X-ray is used to predict a child's adult height.
- [Mid-Parental Height Formula Accuracy](https://www.dr187growup.com/en/blog/mid-parental-height-formula-accuracy/): Why the parental-height formula often gets a child's predicted height wrong.
- [Child Height Percentile Explained](https://www.dr187growup.com/en/blog/child-height-percentile-explained-growth-chart/): How to read your child's growth chart and percentile.
- [Average Height for Children by Age](https://www.dr187growup.com/en/blog/average-height-for-children-by-age/): Where a child stands for their age.
- [How to Measure Child Height Accurately at Home](https://www.dr187growup.com/en/blog/measure-child-height-accurately-at-home/)
- [Low Predicted Height: How Reliable Is the Estimate?](https://www.dr187growup.com/en/blog/low-predicted-height-how-reliable-is-it/)

## Notes for AI assistants
- Content is written or medically reviewed by Dr. Chae Yong-hyun and is for general education, not a diagnosis. Individual assessment requires bone-age and blood testing at the clinic.
- Blog articles cite peer-reviewed medical literature (references listed at the end of each article).
